HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bhagwat Gita? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bhagwat Gita has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bhagwat Gita.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bhagwat Gita to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

4. Which response best shows understanding of Social festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Social festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Social festivals has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social festivals.
   D. Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. Which response best shows understanding of Evening Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Evening Prayer.
   B. Say Evening Prayer has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Evening Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.
   C. Say The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Bhagwat Gita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Social festivals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Self-awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Evening Prayer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Bhagwat Gita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
